snippet.description:
Truth Table Discrete Mathematics Mathematical Logic solved examples: Learn Tautology, Contradiction, Implication, Conditional Statements, Equivalence, and Bit Operations step by step.

Truth Table Discrete Mathematics Mathematical Logic solved examples: Learn Tautology, Contradiction, Implication, Conditional Statements, Equivalence, and Bit Operations step by step.

Hello Learners! Welcome to Fractal Frontier Maths.

Is video lecture me hum Mathematical Logic aur Discrete Mathematics ke important concepts aur illustrative examples cover kar rahe hain:

🔹 Topics Covered:

Proofs using Truth Tables (सत्यमान सारणी)
Conditional ($P \rightarrow Q$) & Bi-conditional ($P \leftrightarrow Q$) Statements
Tautology, Contradiction (विरोधी कथन), aur Logical Equivalence (तुल्य कथन)
NAND ($\uparrow$), NOR ($\downarrow$), aur XOR ($\oplus$) Logic
Truth Tables for 3-variable compound statements ($P, Q, R$)
Binary Bit Operations (0 & 1 logic) with solved exercises

Timestamps
00:00 – Introduction & Recap of Propositional Logic Laws
01:45 – Example 1: Proving Contradictory Statements using Truth Tables
06:12 – Example 2: Truth Tables for Conditional Statements & Implications
18:15 – Example 3: 3-Variable Truth Tables ($P, Q, R$)
31:16 – Example 4: Proving Logical Equivalence using Truth Tables
35:30 – Example 5: NAND ($\uparrow$), NOR ($\downarrow$) & XOR ($\oplus$) Logic
42:04 – Introduction to Binary Bit Operations ($0$ & $1$ Logic)
43:46 – Example 6: Evaluating Binary Bit Operations
52:54 – Practice Exercise Questions & Conclusion

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics
